clips.title: The story
paras: At Maestra's Post, Delgren the Purifier aids the night elves against demonic and shadow magic on Ashenvale's northern edge. He works with Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand to guard the frontier.

Delgren the Purifier keeps watch over travelers heading south from Auberdine. Human paladins are rare in Kalimdor's ancient forests, but he came west with a band of holy warriors from the Argent Dawn. They set out to help the Alliance's new night elf allies face demons and undead remnants left by the Third War. Delgren is stationed near the border of Darkshore and Ashenvale, where that danger reaches the road.

Delgren's devotion to the Holy Light has not kept him from studying Kalimdor's tangled politics. He learned Orcish, to the annoyance and disdain of his conservative superiors. The language gives him a way to understand the enemies and neighbors who share this untamed continent, beyond the teachings of his order.
